_comment: Issue templates expanded per project by the importer. Each project receives one issue per template (so every project covers all five statuses). dueOffsetDays is relative to 2026-01-01; negative = past. attachment references a file under assets/attachments. comments[].internal marks internal notes; comments[].by is a member slot index (0=assignee/creator, rotates).

templates.title: Inspect and recoat hull below waterline
templates.description: Grit-blast and apply anti-fouling per the coating spec. Confirm anode condition during the same docking.

comments.text: Logged from the pre-docking walk-through. Confirm scope before we release to the yard.
Awaiting paint lead time from Nordic Coatings before scheduling.

templates.title: Replace bridge navigation radar
templates.description: Swap the bridge radar unit and verify integration with the ECDIS and AIS.

comments.text: Crew assigned and old unit removed. New unit on site.
Holding at ~60% — waiting on the integration cable from RadarTech.
Subcontractor confirmed for the commissioning step.

templates.title: Annual safety equipment audit
templates.description: Audit liferafts, EPIRBs, fire systems, and lifejackets; compile the class submission.

comments.text: Audit walkthrough complete; findings compiled for review.
Please review the checklist before I submit to class.

templates.title: Overhaul main engine top end
templates.description: Top-end overhaul at the scheduled running-hour interval. Replace injectors and gaskets.

comments.text: Overhaul completed and area cleaned up.
Sea trial passed; signed off by the chief engineer.
Records filed with class.

templates.title: Replace sacrificial anodes
templates.description: Replace consumed sacrificial anodes across the hull and running gear.

comments.text: All anodes replaced; old ones logged.

templates.title: Update ECDIS charts and licences
templates.description: Apply the latest ENC update and renew chart licences.

templates.title: Repair HVAC compressor
templates.description: Diagnose and repair the failing AC compressor serving the guest cabins.

comments.text: Compressor isolated; ordering a replacement seal kit.

templates.title: Service tender crane hydraulics
templates.description: Routine service of the tender crane hydraulic system.

comments.text: Cancelled — folded into the broader deck-equipment work order.

_shipComment: Ship-preset projects draw from this set instead of `templates`: a vessel's own backlog is class-survey findings, defect reports, spares requisitions and drydock items, not the office backlog its refit sub-projects carry. The importer gives each ship a rotating 3-5 template window, so no two adjacent vessels look alike.

shipTemplates.title: Class survey finding: shell plating wastage aft
shipTemplates.description: Attending surveyor recorded plating diminution beyond allowance in way of frames 12-18. Prepare the repair proposal and thickness measurement report for class approval.

comments.text: Ultrasonic readings taken; three plates fall below the wastage limit.
Repair proposal drafted — holding for the surveyor's countersignature.

shipTemplates.title: Defect report: No.2 generator low insulation resistance
shipTemplates.description: Megger reading on the No.2 generator stator dropped below 1 MΩ. Generator isolated and tagged out; drying-out in progress.

comments.text: Generator isolated and locked out. Space heaters running.
Reading recovering slowly — retest scheduled in 48 hours.

shipTemplates.title: Drydock item: tailshaft withdrawal and clearance check
shipTemplates.description: Withdraw the tailshaft at the next docking, record bearing clearances and renew the aft seal. Class attendance required for the clearance readings.

shipTemplates.title: Spares requisition: main engine injector set
shipTemplates.description: Onboard injector spares are down to one set. Raise the requisition to restore the minimum stock level before the next running-hour service.

comments.text: Stock check confirms one spare set remaining.

shipTemplates.title: Port state control deficiency: emergency lighting
shipTemplates.description: PSC inspection raised a deficiency against emergency lighting levels in the engine room escape route. Fittings renewed and re-tested.

comments.text: Fittings renewed; lux readings now within requirement.
Deficiency cleared by the attending officer.

shipTemplates.title: Liferaft annual service due
shipTemplates.description: Both liferafts are due their annual service at an approved station. Verify the hydrostatic release expiry while the rafts are ashore.

comments.text: Rafts landed at the service station; certificates pending.

shipTemplates.title: Defect report: bilge high-level alarm intermittent
shipTemplates.description: Engine room bilge high-level alarm fails to annunciate on test roughly one attempt in three. Float switch suspected.

comments.text: Float switch cleaned and re-tested; fault still intermittent. Replacement sensor requisitioned.

shipTemplates.title: Anchor chain calibration and marking
shipTemplates.description: Chain ranged on the dock bottom, links gauged and shackles re-marked. Two links replaced at the bitter end.

comments.text: Chain ranged and gauged; report filed with the docking record.

shipTemplates.title: Bunker fuel sample analysis out of spec
shipTemplates.description: Laboratory analysis of the last bunker returned catalytic fines above the engine maker's limit. Do not consume until the purifier throughput is reduced and a second sample clears.

comments.text: Tank isolated from the service system pending the retest.

shipTemplates.title: Ballast tank internal survey deferred
shipTemplates.description: Internal survey of the aft peak was cancelled — class agreed to defer it into the next intermediate survey window.

comments.text: Deferral confirmed in writing by class; folded into the intermediate survey scope.
